text: Claude Fable 5.2 is now available in Devin Desktop and Devin CLI. On FrontierCode 2.0, Fable 5.2 takes the #1 spot at a score of 49.1. Fable 5.2 also introduces a significant price improvement from Fable 5.1: at low reasoning effort, it surpasses its predecessor’s score at a third of the cost. 💬38🔄32❤️474👀51056📊89 ⚡ Powered by xgo.ing
